title_zh: 选定先看磨坊再看矿业展区的路线

scenario.label_zh: 选定先看磨坊再看矿业展区的路线
scenario.goal_zh: 区分磨坊中的粮食加工与矿坑展区，并选定相应参观顺序

context_zh: 游客在虚构工业遗产公园询问两处展区的内容与步行安排。
author: author-phase11-c

sentences.speaker: Alice
sentences.text: Does the old mill belong to the mining exhibition? I only have an hour here.

sentences.speaker: Martin
sentences.text: They’re separate. The mill ground grain. One display follows a peasant family bringing its harvest there.

sentences.speaker: Alice
sentences.text: So where do I see how people worked underground?

sentences.speaker: Martin
sentences.text: That’s in the mining gallery beside the old pit. The pit itself is closed to visitors.

sentences.speaker: Alice
sentences.text: Can I walk from the mill to that gallery without going near the closed area?

sentences.speaker: Martin
sentences.text: Yes. The marked path connects both entrances and stays outside the fence.

sentences.speaker: Alice
sentences.text: Then I’ll start at the mill and follow that path to the gallery.
